notices.message: The agent was unavailable for this run, so the plan was assembled by the deterministic planner.
Qloo scores each country's heatmap on its own scale, so Opener picks the strongest cities in each country (United States, Canada) instead of ranking countries against each other.

limitations: Qloo heatmap affinity is relative to this query. It shows where the audience over-indexes, not ticket demand or venue capacity.
Cities are derived by Opener from Qloo heat cells using a bundled GeoNames table; cells more than 90 km from a listed city are left out.
Demographic values are relative affinities (above or below average), not shares of fans.
Dates, drive times, venue availability and capacity are not modelled yet.
Heatmap scores are relative within each country searched, so cities in different countries are not ranked against each other.
